name: dealer-call-transcript-classifier
description: Classify car dealership call transcripts into five categories (Sales / Service / Parts / Finance / Other) with strict honesty rules that never inflate the Sales count. Auto-detects input format (single transcript, batch paste, CallRail or CRM export). For Sales-classified calls, extracts vehicle of interest, lead source, and contact captured. Designed for dealer principals, GMs, BDC managers, and agencies who need honest top-of-funnel numbers.
